technology_name: Ready to Cook Tubers, Starchy Vegetables and Pulse
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
technology_type:
Convenience Food Technology,
Functional Food Processing Technology,
Value-Added Food Product Technology
problem_solved: Time-consuming preparation of nutritious regional foods and changing dietary habits leading to nutrient deficiencies
description: This technology enables the production of ready-to-cook foods from regional crops rich in carbohydrates, micronutrients, and phytochemicals. It is designed to reduce cooking time while retaining the nutritional value of traditional foods. The products help meet nutritional requirements with less effort in the kitchen and support convenient consumption of healthy regional foods.
applications:
Ready-to-cook and convenience food manufacturers
Food processing MSMEs and agri-food startups
Institutional catering and food service providers
Retail and community nutrition programs
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and value-addition enterprises for regional crops
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
